name: Tsuma Karu ~Hitozuma Ryoujoku Culture School~
original_name: 妻カル ～人妻陵辱狩ルチャースクール～
source:
The protagonist of this game is a man who has a thing for older women, especially married ones.
A cooking school aimed at housewives sends him a request to become a teacher.
The man considers that this could be the ideal way to find his ideal housewife.
Thus he accepts the offer, looking forward to what is to come. However, it turns out the school's attendants are all old ladies who are far from what he had in mind.
The man is about to give up when two women appear at the school who meet his ideals perfectly.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039821.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这个游戏的主角是一个喜欢年长女性，尤其是已婚女性的男人。
一所针对家庭主妇的烹饪学校向他发出了成为一名教师的请求。
该男子认为这可能是寻找理想家庭主妇的理想方式。
因此，他接受了这个提议，并期待着即将发生的事情。然而，原来学校的服务员都是老太太，与他想象的相去甚远。
男人正要放弃，学校里出现了两个完美符合他理想的女人。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039821.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
